cases.text: A newly disclosed vulnerability in a file transfer application allows remote code execution. The vendor published a patch and assigned a CVE identifier.
Although attackers have exploited the flaw, this advisory explains the newly disclosed authentication vulnerability, affected versions and available patches.
Researchers analyzed a ransomware campaign targeting health care. The report describes the operators' phishing techniques, malware delivery and lateral movement methods.
A threat actor uses stolen credentials and legitimate administration tools to move through corporate networks. Researchers describe its techniques and infrastructure.
A hospital reported that ransomware encrypted its patient records on Monday. Appointments were postponed. Investigators are determining how the attackers entered the network.
A retailer confirmed a breach affecting two million customer records. Attackers used a previously disclosed software flaw. The retailer notified affected customers and restored its systems.
Parliament approved new cybersecurity legislation requiring companies to report data breaches. The debate centered on reporting obligations, oversight powers and implementation deadlines.
The government announced an election for November. Political parties will publish their manifestos next month and begin negotiations about potential coalitions.

A manufacturing company reported quarterly revenue of ten million euros. Operating costs increased by three percent. Management will discuss the results on Friday.

Rain is forecast across the region on Thursday. Temperatures will range between ten and fifteen degrees. Dry conditions are expected to return during the weekend.
